sections.content: Report from dashboard: Connectivity. Generated automatically by DBDOME.

sections.query:
select server, connect_time, net_transport, protocol_type, endpoint_id, encrypt_option, auth_scheme, node_affinity, num_reads, num_writes, last_read, last_write, net_packet_size, client_net_address, client_tcp_port, local_net_address, local_tcp_port
from monitoring.tcp_connections 
order by connect_Time desc
